summary: LoginNewProgram is a data access layer class responsible for retrieving and organizing a list of new HSPnet programs for a user session. It fetches program data from the database using a stored procedure and structures the results into objects for further use.
purpose: To provide a structured list of newly available HSPnet programs for a user session, including program names and associated PC lists.

entities.name: ProgramItem
entities.description: Represents a program with its name and PC list.

entities.name: LoginNewProgram
entities.description: Main class handling retrieval and presentation of new programs.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Concatenation of LongName and ShortName from database.

fields.name: PCList
fields.description: PC list associated with the program from database.

actors.name: User
actors.role: Session owner; receives list of new programs.

workflows.name: Retrieve New Programs Workflow
steps: Execute stored procedure and obtain SqlDataReader.
For each record, create ProgramItem, populate Name and PCList, add to Data list.

business_rules: Only programs retrieved from 'LoginWelcomeNewHSPnetPrograms' stored procedure are shown.
validations: Check for null SqlDataReader before processing.

calculations.description: ProgramItem.Name is calculated as concatenation of LongName and ShortName with a comma separator.

conditions.description: If SqlDataReader is null, no data is processed.

system_behavior: On LoginNewProgram object creation, the list of new programs is automatically loaded.
Uses database abstraction from HSPnetSession for procedure execution and data retrieval.

exceptions.description: No explicit exception handling found; processing stops if SqlDataReader is null.

content_gaps: No information on error handling for failed database calls.
No user interface or presentation logic described.
No details on the structure or format of PCList.
